_comment: Controls which performances appear on the PUBLIC calendar.
Anything hidden here never reaches availability.json at all, so it
cannot be found by the public. Private shows stay fully purchasable
public_showtimes: ONLY these start times appear on the calendar.
Any performance at any other time is treated as private and hidden
automatically -- no action needed when a private show is added.
hide: specific performances to hide regardless of their time.
Use "YYYY-MM-DD" to hide a whole day, or "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM"
